decisions.question: No shape is adopted for storage-write-committed; it stays counts-only and internal. Prototyping and measuring continue as input. Reopen when all four are in hand: (1) WC-STEP-PATCH's WriteResult.items[], so records are named from the write's own result, as API v3's storage events already are; (2) a named first subscriber and its exactness need (screen refresh, or sync and alarms); (3) the BF-164 AndroidAPS websocket cursor finding re-measured; (4) a count of sites running on a replica set, where change streams are the exact source.

options.label: Reopen with the four inputs
options.gains: the shape is chosen against a real subscriber and the write's own result

options.label: Read records after the write
options.gains: exact names without a pre-read; being prototyped and measured (session -2e), with a capped pre-read as the comparison
options.risks: no surveyed system does this; precedents name records from the database log (change streams, Debezium, PostgreSQL logical decoding) or by reading before the write (Nocturne, Sequelize individualHooks, Django delete)
